changes.reason: The CLI validates the minimum JSON envelope and known endpoint state before reporting an operational endpoint as available. The remote Host, Provider and deployment contracts do not change.

kubernetes.reason: Local CLI payload validation only; no Node Host, cluster, storage or application lifecycle behavior changes.

aws-lambda.reason: The CLI inspects an existing HTTP response; Lambda invocation, initialization and flush ownership are unchanged.

cloudflare.reason: The CLI inspects an existing HTTP response; no Workers isolate capability, binding or Node Container support is introduced.
